import zipfile
from collections import Counter
from statistics import mean, median


def parse_fasta(text):
    records=[]; name=None; chunks=[]
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line=line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        if line.startswith('>'):
            if name is not None:
                records.append((name,''.join(chunks)))
            name=line[1:].split()[0]; chunks=[]
        else:
            chunks.append(line)
    if name is not None:
        records.append((name,''.join(chunks)))
    return records

def pis_count(records, gap_mode):
    seqs=[s.upper() for _,s in records]
    lens={len(s) for s in seqs}
    if len(lens)"'!=1:
        raise ValueError(lens)
    n=0
    for col in zip(*seqs):
        if gap_mode=='"'exclude':
            vals=[c for c in col if c not in '-?NnXx'] # for aa, X unknown too
        elif gap_mode=='exclude_gap_only':
            vals=[c for c in col if c not in '-?']
        elif gap_mode=='include':
            vals=list(col)
        counts=Counter(vals)
        if sum(1 for v in counts.values() if v>=2) >= 2:
            n += 1
    return n

def group_counts(zip_path, mode):
    out=[]
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as z:
        for name in sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft')):
            records=parse_fasta(z.read(name).decode())
            out.append((name,pis_count(records, mode)))
    return out

def ranks(data):
    # data list (value, group idx). average ranks 1-based for ties
    order=sorted(range(len(data)), key=lambda i:data[i][0])
    r=[None]*len(data)
    i=0
    while i<len(order):
        j=i+1
        while j<len(order) and data[order[j]][0]==data[order[i]][0]:
            j+=1
        avg=(i+1+j)/2
        for k in order[i:j]: r[k]=avg
        i=j
    return r

def mann_u(x,y):
    data=[(v,0) for v in x]+[(v,1) for v in y]
    rs=ranks(data)
    n1=len(x); n2=len(y)
    R1=sum(rs[:n1])
    U1=R1-n1*(n1+1)/2
    U2=n1*n2-U1
    return U1,U2

for mode in ['exclude_gap_only','exclude','include']:
    a=group_counts('inputs/scogs_animals.zip', mode)
    f=group_counts('inputs/scogs_fungi.zip', mode)
    av=[v for _,v in a]; fv=[v for _,v in f]
    u1,u2=mann_u(av,fv)
    print('\\nMODE',mode)
    print('n',len(av),len(fv),'sum',sum(av),sum(fv),'mean',mean(av),mean(fv),'median',median(av),median(fv),'minmax',min(av),max(av),min(fv),max(fv))
    print('U animals',u1,'U fungi',u2,'smaller',min(u1,u2))
    print('first5 animal',a[:5])
    print('first5 fungi',f[:5])
PY"

AA_MISSING_AMBIG=set('BJZX.*-?')

def parse_fasta(text):
    records=[]; name=None; chunks=[]
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        line=raw.strip()
        if not line: continue
        if line.startswith('>'):
            if name is not None:
                records.append((name,''.join(chunks)))
            name=line[1:].split()[0]; chunks=[]
        else:
            chunks.append(line)
    if name is not None:
        records.append((name,''.join(chunks)))
    return records

def pis_count(records):
    seqs=[s.upper() for _,s in records]
    lens={len(s) for s in seqs}
    if len(lens)"'!=1:
        raise ValueError(lens)
    n=0
    for site in zip(*seqs):
        vals=[c for c in site if c not in AA_MISSING_AMBIG]
        counts=Counter(vals)
        if sum(1 for c in counts if counts[c] >= 2) >= 2:
            n += 1
    return n

def group_counts(zp):
    out=[]
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zp) as z:
        for name in sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('"'.faa.mafft')):
            records=parse_fasta(z.read(name).decode('utf-8'))
            out.append((name,len(records),pis_count(records)))
    return out

def mann_u(x,y):
    vals=x+y
    groups=[0]*len(x)+[1]*len(y)
    order=sorted(range(len(vals)), key=lambda i: vals[i])
    ranks=[0.0]*len(vals)
    i=0
    while i<len(order):
        j=i+1
        while j<len(order) and vals[order[j]]==vals[order[i]]:
            j+=1
        avg=(i+1+j)/2.0
        for k in order[i:j]:
            ranks[k]=avg
        i=j
    n1=len(x); n2=len(y)
    r1=sum(ranks[:n1])
    u1=r1-n1*(n1+1)/2.0
    return u1, n1*n2-u1
